headline: Alonso starts the Singapore Grand Prix from the pit lane
body: Alonso moves from 16th on the provisional grid to a pit-lane start after Aston Martin changed his suspension setup under parc fermé and worked beyond the covers-on time. He also has a new turbocharger, his sixth of the season.

headline: Stroll starts the Singapore Grand Prix from the pit lane
body: Stroll moves from 18th on the provisional grid to a pit-lane start after Aston Martin changed his suspension setup under parc fermé. The team also continued working on his car beyond the covers-on time.

headline: Hadjar starts the Singapore Grand Prix from the pit lane
body: Hadjar must start from the pit lane after Red Bull changed his car under parc fermé and fitted additional power-unit elements. He retains permission to race after failing to set a qualifying time.

headline: Russell’s Singapore grid penalty rises to 60 places
body: Russell has received another 20-place grid penalty for using his fourth energy store and control electronics unit. That brings his combined Singapore penalty to 60 places.

headline: FIA admits Singapore SQ1 error compromised fairness
body: The FIA says a missed race-control prompt left Overtake Mode disabled after the SQ1 red flag. Briefly switching it back on for 27 seconds affected drivers unequally; single-seater director Nikolas Tombazis acknowledged that the error interfered with the results and said it is being analysed to prevent a repeat.

headline: Gasly questions no penalty for Norris after the sprint collision
body: Gasly questioned the decision to take no action over Norris and Piastri's sprint collision, saying he would have scored a point if Norris had been penalised. He wants to discuss consistency with the stewards after Colapinto received a penalty for hitting him in Baku; Singapore's ruling remains unchanged.

headline: Final starting grid for the Singapore Grand Prix
body: Verstappen and Leclerc share the front row, ahead of Hamilton and Antonelli. Russell starts 19th with a combined 60-place power-unit penalty. Alonso, Stroll and Hadjar start from the pit lane after car changes under parc fermé.
